scope: Headline: Jovian observations only, deduplicated by absolute UTC. perPlatformRegression independently compares every saved official platform; agreement does not establish independent backends

comparisonPolicy.type: Saved myBodyGraph Chinese display labels explicitly translated to canonical HD type, original observed and predicted labels retained
comparisonPolicy.activations: Exact Gate.Line; no official longitude or color/tone/base observations claimed
comparisonPolicy.incarnationCross: Angle + name + ordered four gates; Sharp variant suffix omitted because Jovian does not display it; Endeavour/Endeavor and optional article The normalized
comparisonPolicy.authority: Lunar and Lunar Cycle denote same authority
comparisonPolicy.strategy: Strategy family comparison. Projector Recognition and Invitation / Invitation mapped together. MG Wait to Respond / Wait to Respond then Inform mapped to response family. Additional Inform text remains a literal display difference and is not claimed to be exact Jovian wording
